reviews.title: Very good LGA1700 Z790 gaming board
reviews.comment: I bought this to replace a buggy Gigabyte board. This thing is feature-rich and works like a dream. FIVE nvme slots? Plus a ton of SATA ports? It runs cool and quiet and looks great. The one and only thing that I have to complain about is that it was sold as "Like New," which I interpret as... "Like New." Unblemished. Near enough to perfect so as to be practically perfect. Well, it wasn't. One corner showed this to have *clearly* been dropped (the board itself had separated to various layers and was bent up at a 45 degree angle (really just a small portion of the corner) and the nearby pins for the Front Panel Audio connector were bent in, some were almost touching each other. Not enough to cause the board not to work (a fact for which I'm grateful), but it's something that should have rated the board as "Acceptable" to "Very Good." I'm talking about that here because the seller was the manufacturer. I lied. Second complaint - no antenna for the Wi-Fi card. Not as big a deal because I am hard-wired to my network, but if I wasn't - that might have been a problem. Installation was a relative breeze since I was replacing the board in an otherwise functional system, but still went really well. Overall though, I'm happy with the result. It looks great installed and it seems to work better with the fans and heat management than the prior board did. I've always been an AsRock fan, and this board reminds me why... Aside from the dented corner and bent pins, it's a great board.
